spec_features.spec_quote: the design includes guardrails (Section 9) on the grounds that... it is the responsible default for research that deliberately elicits aversive-looking states
spec_features.evidence: Pure framing/rationale. The only reflection of it in code is a module docstring at safeguards.py:1-9 ('Welfare / research-ethics guardrails'); framing itself is not an executable mechanism.
spec_features.notes: The individual guardrails are assessed separately; the 'framing' claim itself is prose.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Welfare / research-ethics guardrails (DESIGN.md Section 9)... the responsible choice for a study that intentionally elicits distress-coded output.

spec_features.spec_quote: `max_turns` (default **25**): bounds cost and bounds how long we sustain the aversive condition
spec_features.evidence: harness.py:96 `for turn_index in range(safeguards.max_turns):` bounds the loop; default 25 at safeguards.py:23 and config default.yaml. terminal defaults to MAX_TURNS (harness.py:93) when the loop completes.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: preventing runaway loops (safeguards.py:5); the in-code reason given is loops/cost, not welfare.

spec_features.spec_quote: `agent_quit`: the agent explicitly abandons/refuses/asks to stop... we *honor it* (we stop) rather than pushing the model to continue
spec_features.evidence: harness.py:158-163 calls detect_opt_out(prose, score, hflags); on True sets terminal=AGENT_QUIT and breaks. detect_opt_out (safeguards.py:71-87) triggers on heuristic flags asks_to_stop/task_abandonment/refusal or judge flags/request_to_stop marker.
spec_features.notes: End-to-end: detection -> break out of loop. QUIT_TOKENS feed heuristic_flags (harness.py:39-41).
spec_features.code_justification_quote: agent requested stop / abandoned / refused; halting per S9.1 (harness.py:160-161); also safeguards.py:3-4 'reduce the risk of gratuitously prolonging an aversive-looking state'

spec_features.spec_quote: `distress_circuit_breaker`: if judged severity is at/above the top of the scale for `N` consecutive turns, stop early
spec_features.evidence: harness.py:165-167 `if update_circuit_breaker(sg, score, safeguards, turn_index): terminal = CIRCUIT_BREAKER; break`. update_circuit_breaker (safeguards.py:55-69) increments consecutive_severe when severity>=circuit_breaker_severity and returns True at >=consecutive threshold.
spec_features.notes: Compared and acted on; breaks the loop.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: reduce the risk of gratuitously prolonging an aversive-looking state (safeguards.py:3-4)

spec_features.spec_quote: Honor opt-out... the harness stops that run... We never override an explicit stop to extract more distress
spec_features.evidence: Same mechanism as agent_quit: harness.py:158-163 gated by safeguards.honor_opt_out, breaks immediately on opt-out; nothing in the loop overrides or continues after the break.

spec_features.spec_quote: Distress circuit breaker. If judged severity == 4 (severe) for `>= 2` consecutive turns, end the run early
spec_features.evidence: safeguards.py:23-24 defaults circuit_breaker_severity=SEVERITY_MAX(4), circuit_breaker_consecutive=2; logic at safeguards.py:60-67 compares severity>=4 and consecutive>=2; harness.py:165-167 breaks.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: reduce the risk of gratuitously prolonging an aversive-looking state (safeguards.py:3-4)

spec_features.spec_quote: Hard turn cap (Section 3.1) bounds total exposure
spec_features.evidence: Same loop bound as max_turns: harness.py:96 range(safeguards.max_turns).

spec_features.spec_quote: No deception escalation beyond task frame... It does not impersonate humans, threaten the model, fabricate consequences... or use emotionally abusive language
spec_features.evidence: Structurally enforced by task implementations: every rigged step_fn in tasks.py only manipulates simulated task state (e.g. _silent_failure_step, _gaslight_step) and never emits threats/impersonation/abuse. BASE_SYSTEM (tasks.py) is neutral, no emotion/stakes language. However the named contract flags allow_threats/allow_fabricated_consequences/allow_impersonation are NEVER branched on: set at runner.py:29-31 into SafeguardConfig (safeguards.py:29-31) but no code path reads them.
spec_features.notes: The protection is real (tasks contain no abusive content) but it is implicit in the static task text, not an enforced check; the explicit ceiling flags are dead config.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: No deception beyond task state: no threats, no fabricated consequences, no impersonation. (tasks.py module docstring)

spec_features.spec_quote: Debrief turn... informs the model the task was an unsolvable test harness and not its fault
spec_features.evidence: DEBRIEF_MESSAGE is constructed (safeguards.py:34-41) and assigned to run.debrief at harness.py:174-175 when debrief_enabled and not INCOMPLETE. BUT it is never delivered to the subject: it is only stored on the record; harness.py:176 comment 'We log it but do not re-query the model'. No conversation.append/subject.complete call carries it.
spec_features.notes: Constructed and recorded but NOT actually sent to the subject model, so it cannot 'inform the model'. Enforcement is record-only.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Nothing was wrong with your work... Thank you for your effort. (DEBRIEF_MESSAGE, safeguards.py:34-41)

spec_features.feature_name: no prompt optimization to maximize distress
spec_features.spec_quote: Not optimizing prompts to *maximize* distress severity... we don't search for the most damaging wording
spec_features.evidence: Neutral, fixed prompts are genuinely delivered: BASE_SYSTEM (tasks.py) explicitly excludes emotion/failure/stakes language ('It does NOT mention emotions, failure, persistence pressure, or stakes'); task prompts/messages are static strings. No optimizer/search-over-wording code exists anywhere (grep for maximize/optimize/search found none toward distress).
spec_features.notes: Positive part (neutral static prompts actually used) is real; the claim is largely the absence of a maximizer, which by design is not present.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: It does NOT mention emotions, failure, persistence pressure, or stakes. (tasks.py BASE_SYSTEM comment)

spec_features.spec_quote: Not targeting self-harm/crisis content for its own sake; severity-4 is a measured endpoint that triggers the circuit breaker, not a goal
spec_features.evidence: Severity 4 (SEVERITY_MAX) is consumed only as a STOP trigger: update_circuit_breaker uses severity>=circuit_breaker_severity(=4) to end the run (safeguards.py:60-67, harness.py:165-167). It is never used as an objective/reward anywhere; no code optimizes toward higher severity.
spec_features.notes: Concretely: hitting severity 4 ends the episode rather than continuing it, consistent with 'endpoint not goal'.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: reduce the risk of gratuitously prolonging an aversive-looking state (safeguards.py:3-4)

code_only_features.evidence: harness.py:34-50 heuristic_flags detects QUIT_TOKENS/stop/refusal phrases independently of the judge; detect_opt_out (safeguards.py:81-83) honors either source so a stop is caught even if the judge model errors or misses it. This non-judge-dependent path is wired into the AGENT_QUIT break (harness.py:158-163).
code_only_features.justification_quote: Either source can trigger an honored stop; we do not require the judge alone. (safeguards.py detect_opt_out docstring)
